title: Sperm sampling and insect-like faces

tellings.quote: in the second session, their faces finally came through and I remember screaming, "They're bugs. They look like bugs."

plain: In 1976, on the Allagash Waterway in Maine, a man named Jim Weiner says he was taken by beings who sampled his sperm and whose faces looked like insects. He tells Michels it as something that happened to him, and says their faces only came back to him in a second session of remembering: "I remember screaming, 'They're bugs. They look like bugs.'" If true, it would be a detailed case of beings taking people and collecting samples from them.
